name: syncwrite
description: Collaborative code editor with AI intelligence, CRDT sync, and terminal execution

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -p "[{name}]" -n "SERVER,CLIENT" -c "yellow.bold,cyan.bold" "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server
scripts.clean: npm run clean -w client && npm run clean -w server && npm run clean -w shared
